formulas.title: Formulas and constants
formulas.description: false turns off the panel of formulas and constants for everyone, and its option cannot turn it on.

converter.title: Converter
converter.description: false turns off the unit converter for everyone, and its option cannot turn it on.

graph.title: Graph
graph.description: false turns off the graph for everyone, with its own window, and its option cannot turn it on.

solve.title: Solve
solve.description: false turns off the solver of equations, calculus and probability for everyone, and its option cannot turn it on.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: false turns off the statistics for everyone, and its option cannot turn it on.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: false turns off the panel of matrices, complex numbers, bases, prime factors and rounding for everyone, and its option cannot turn it on.

detachedMode.title: Detached Mode
detachedMode.description: false turns off the calculator in a window of its own, and with it the calculator button on every page, which opens that window.

pageButton.title: Calculator on every page
pageButton.description: false turns off the calculator button on the side of every page, and its option cannot turn it on.
